customCode.body: 카카오톡 상담 네이버 톡톡 상담

<style>
/* ==========================================================
   타이포그래피 재조정 (위계 완화 + 자간 정상화)
   레이아웃/이미지/문구/색상은 유지
========================================================== */

/* H1 (40px) */
.hero-title,
.hero-title p {
  font-size: 40px !important;
  line-height: 1.4 !important;
  letter-spacing: 0 !important;
}

/* 섹션 리드문 / 히어로 서브카피 (16px) */
.hero-description,
.hero-description p,
.section-copy,
.section-copy p,
.care-section-copy,
.care-section-copy p,
.intro-panel p {
  font-size: 16px !important;
  line-height: 1.8 !important;
}

/* H2 (27px) */
.section-title,
.section-title p,
.section-heading,
.section-heading p,
.care-section-heading,
.care-section-heading p,
.intro-panel h2 {
  font-size: 27px !important;
  line-height: 1.4 !important;
  letter-spacing: 0 !important;
}

/* 영문 라벨 / 번호 (13px) */
.eyebrow,
.eyebrow .number,
.eyebrow span {
  font-size: 13px !important;
}

/* H3 (19px) */
.step-title,
.process-card h3,
.process-card h4,
.care-card h3,
.habit-content h3,
.process-head h2,
.quote-title,
.quote-title p {
  font-size: 19px !important;
  line-height: 1.4 !important;
  letter-spacing: 0 !important;
}

/* 카드 제목 (16px) */
.card-title,
.card-title p {
  font-size: 16px !important;
  line-height: 1.4 !important;
}

/* 일반 본문 (16px, line-height 1.8) */
p {
  font-size: 16px !important;
  line-height: 1.8 !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.01em !important;
}

/* 카드 설명 (14px, line-height 1.7) */
.step-description,
.process-card p,
.care-card p,
.habit-content p {
  font-size: 14px !important;
  line-height: 1.7 !important;
}

/* 캐션 / 작은 설명 (14px) */
.concern-card p,
.case-info,
.mini-tags,
.image-labels span,
.movement-note span,
.brand-subtitle {
  font-size: 14px !important;
  line-height: 1.7 !important;
}

/* 버튼 (14.5px) */
.arrow-link,
.diagnosis-button,
.primary-button,
.booking-outline,
.cta-btn {
  font-size: 14.5px !important;
}

/* GNB (14.5px) */
.main-nav a {
  font-size: 14.5px !important;
}

/* 좋은 카드 안 좋은 제목이 지나치게 좌이는 레이아웃 보정:
   좁은 라벨 칼럼을 쓰는 공유 레이아웃에 최소 폭 확보 (이미지/전체 구조는 유지) */
.section-layout {
  grid-template-columns: minmax(230px, 26%) minmax(0, 1fr) !important;
}
</style>
<style>
/* 헤더 메뉴 줄바꿈 보정 */
.site-header .brand { flex-shrink: 0; }
.site-header .brand > span { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.site-header .brand-name { white-space: nowrap; }
.site-header .brand-subtitle { font-size: 11px !important; line-height: 1.3 !important; white-space: nowrap; }
.site-header .main-nav { gap: clamp(22px, 2.6vw, 52px) !important; margin-right: clamp(24px, 3vw, 70px) !important; }
.site-header .main-nav a { white-space: nowrap; }
.site-header .booking-outline { white-space: nowrap; }
@media (max-width: 1366px) {
  .site-header .main-nav { gap: 20px !important; margin-right: 24px !important; }
  .site-header .main-nav a { font-size: 13.5px !important; }
}
@media (max-width: 1239px) {
  .site-header .main-nav { display: none !important; }
}

/* 홈 '30분의 첫 만남' 카드: 링크 칸을 아래로 내려 카드 폭 확보 */
@media (min-width: 768px) {
  .diagnosis-bottom { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) !important; row-gap: 18px !important; }
  .diagnosis-bottom .diagnosis-links { justify-self: end; }
}
.feature-box strong,
.feature-box p { word-break: keep-all; }
</style>
<style>
/* 본문 서체 굵기 300 → 400 (설명 글씨가 흐려 보이지 않게) */
html:root { --font-weight-body: 400 !important; }

/* 일반진료 '교정 전·중·후' 섹션: 고정 높이 해제 + 모바일·태블릿 가로 나열 */
.journey { height: auto !important; }
.journey .journey-layout { height: auto !important; }
.journey .journey-step p { word-break: keep-all; }
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .journey .journey-steps { display: grid !important; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)) !important; gap: 0 12px !important; }
  .journey .journey-step { min-width: 0; text-align: center; }
  .journey .journey-step .step-image { width: 88px !important; height: 88px !important; margin-left: auto !important; margin-right: auto !important; }
}
@media (max-width: 767px) {
  .journey .journey-step { padding: 0 !important; }
  .journey .journey-step::before { display: none !important; }
  .journey .journey-step .step-image { width: 72px !important; height: 72px !important; }
  .journey .journey-step h3 { font-size: 15px !important; }
  .journey .journey-step p { width: auto !important; max-width: none !important; font-size: 13px !important; line-height: 1.6 !important; }
}
</style>
<style>
/* 치료 중 케어 양치법 문구 가운데 정렬 */
.during-product { text-align: center; }
.during-product strong { font-size: 16px !important; }
.during-product small { font-size: 14px !important; color: #4f4c4a !important; }
/* 부모님이 도와주실 부분 카드 제목 키우기 */
.guidance-section .guide-title { font-size: 16px !important; line-height: 1.45 !important; }

/* ===== 눌러서 펼치는 카드 (모바일) ===== */
.sa-acc-ico { display: none; }
@media (max-width: 767px) {
  .sa-acc { position: relative; cursor: pointer; }
  .sa-acc .sa-acc-body { display: none !important; }
  .sa-acc.sa-open .sa-acc-body { display: block !important; }
  .sa-acc-ico { display: flex; position: absolute; right: 8px; bottom: 8px; width: 22px; height: 22px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid #d9d4d0; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; color: #9a6b55; font: 400 15px/1 Arial, sans-serif; pointer-events: none; z-index: 2; }
  .sa-acc.sa-open .sa-acc-ico { transform: rotate(45deg); }
}

@media (max-width: 767px) {
  /* --- 교정고민: 탭 안 첫 이미지 가로 나열 --- */
  .ct-main-images { grid-template-columns: none !important; grid-auto-flow: column !important; grid-auto-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) !important; gap: 8px !important; }
  .ct-main-img-card img { height: 96px !important; object-fit: cover; }
  .ct-main-img-card figcaption strong { font-size: 14px !important; margin-top: 6px; }
  .ct-main-img-card figcaption span { font-size: 12.5px !important; line-height: 1.5 !important; word-break: keep-all; }

  /* --- 교정진단: 판단기준 첫 사진 숨김 + 카드 2x2 --- */
  .criteria .central-analysis { display: none !important; }
  .criteria .criteria-diagram { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)) !important; gap: 10px !important; }
  .criteria .criteria-card { grid-column: auto !important; grid-row: auto !important; display: flex !important; flex-direction: column-reverse; justify-content: flex-end; padding: 12px 10px !important; min-height: 0 !important; }
  .criteria .criteria-card .card-image { width: 100% !important; height: 64px !important; margin: 0 0 8px !important; background-size: contain !important; background-position: left center !important; }
  .criteria .criteria-card .card-copy { width: auto !important; padding: 0 !important; }
  .criteria .criteria-card p { font-size: 14px !important; line-height: 1.6 !important; word-break: keep-all; }

  /* --- 교정진단: 정밀검사 카드 3열, 이미지 축소, 설명 숨김 --- */
  .exams .exams-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)) !important; gap: 18px 8px !important; }
  .exams .exam-card { flex-direction: column !important; align-items: center !important; text-align: center; padding: 0 !important; min-height: 0 !important; }
  .exams .exam-image { width: 84px !important; height: 84px !important; margin: 0 auto 6px !important; }
  .exams .exam-text { width: auto !important; padding: 0 !important; }
  .exams .exam-text p { display: none !important; }
  .exams .exam-text h3 { font-size: 15px !important; margin: 2px 0 !important; word-break: keep-all; }

  /* --- 교정치료: 탭 3개 가로 --- */
  .treatment-tabs { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)) !important; gap: 0 !important; }
  .treatment-tabs .tab-button { padding: 12px 4px !important; min-height: 52px; justify-content: center !important; text-align: center; }
  .treatment-tabs .tab-text { width: auto !important; }
  .treatment-tabs .tab-text strong { font-size: 14px !important; white-space: nowrap; }
  .treatment-tabs .tab-text small { display: none !important; }

  /* --- 교정치료: 부모님이 도와주실 부분 2x2, 이미지 없음 --- */
  .guidance-section .guidance-cards { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)) !important; gap: 8px !important; }
  .guidance-section .guide-image { display: none !important; }
  .guidance-section .guide-body { padding: 16px 12px !important; }
  .guidance-section .guide-title { align-items: flex-start !important; margin: 0 !important; word-break: keep-all; }
  .guidance-section .guide-body p:empty { display: none; }

  /* --- 교정치료: 구강 습관 / 주의사항 / 착용·점검 카드 2열 --- */
  .habit-grid, .notice-grid, .guide-row .guide-cards { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)) !important; gap: 8px !important; }
  .habit-card img, .notice-photo, .guide-row .guide-image { height: 92px !important; min-height: 0 !important; }
  .guide-row .guide-card { flex-direction: column !important; }
  .guide-row .guide-image { width: 100% !important; }
  .habit-content, .notice-content, .guide-row .card-body { padding: 10px 10px 34px !important; min-height: 0 !important; }
  .habit-content h3, .notice-content h3, .guide-row .card-body h3 { word-break: keep-all; }
  .notice-content h3, .guide-row .card-body h3 { font-size: 15px !important; line-height: 1.4 !important; }

  /* --- 교정치료: 교정 중 치아 관리 3열 --- */
  .care-section .care-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)) !important; gap: 8px !important; }
  .care-section .care-card { padding: 10px 8px 34px !important; }
  .care-section .care-card-header { display: block !important; }
  .care-section .care-card-header h3 { font-size: 15px !important; word-break: keep-all; }
  .care-section .care-card-header h3 span { font-size: 11.5px !important; }
  .care-section .care-photo { height: 70px !important; min-height: 0 !important; margin: 6px 0 !important; }

  /* --- 케어: 교정 전 양치교육을 메인으로, 나머지 이미지 작게 --- */
  .before-care-detail { display: flex !important; flex-direction: column !important; }
  .before-care-education { order: -1; }
  .before-care-feature, .before-care-feature img { height: 190px !important; min-height: 0 !important; object-fit: cover; }
  .before-care-examination { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)) !important; gap: 8px !important; }
  .before-care-exam-card { grid-template-columns: 1fr !important; }
  .before-care-exam-image, .before-care-exam-image img { height: 96px !important; }
  .before-care-exam-card figcaption { padding: 8px !important; }
  .before-care-xray { height: 100% !important; min-height: 0 !important; }
  .before-care-xray img { height: 100% !important; width: 100% !important; object-fit: cover; }
  .before-care-xray-list { display: none !important; }

  /* --- 치료사례: 소제목·내용 가로 나열 --- */
  .data-card, .case-three-content .numbered-item,
  .numbered-item .numbered-copy, .process-copy > div { display: grid !important; grid-template-columns: 96px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 12px; align-items: start; }
  .data-card h3, .case-three-content .numbered-item h3,
  .numbered-item .numbered-copy h3, .process-copy h3 { margin: 2px 0 0 !important; word-break: keep-all; line-height: 1.45 !important; }
  .data-card p, .case-three-content .numbered-item p,
  .numbered-item .numbered-copy p, .process-copy p { font-size: 15px !important; margin: 0 !important; }
  .records .records-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)) !important; gap: 6px !important; }
  .records .record-image { height: 100px !important; }
  .three-process .steps { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)) !important; gap: 8px !important; }
  .case-three-records { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)) !important; gap: 8px !important; }
  .case-three-records .record { height: auto !important; }
  .treatment-meta { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)) !important; }
  .treatment-meta .meta-heading { grid-column: 1 / -1; }

  /* --- 일반진료: 진료 카드 2열, 이미지 위 --- */
  .treatment-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)) !important; gap: 8px !important; }
  .treatment-grid .treatment-card { grid-column: auto !important; grid-row: auto !important; display: flex !important; flex-direction: column-reverse; justify-content: flex-end; min-height: 0 !important; }
  .treatment-grid .card-media, .treatment-grid .card-media img { height: 104px !important; width: 100% !important; }
  .treatment-grid .card-caption { display: none !important; }
  .treatment-grid .card-copy { width: auto !important; padding: 10px 10px 34px !important; }
  .treatment-grid .card-copy h3 { margin: 0 !important; }
}

/* ===== 치료사례: 소제목·라벨이 본문보다 작지 않게 (전체 화면) ===== */
.step-section > h3, .small-comparison > h3, .records > h3, .treatment-meta .meta-heading b { font-size: 16px !important; line-height: 1.4 !important; }
.treatment-meta .meta-item strong { font-size: 15px !important; line-height: 1.4 !important; }
.treatment-meta .meta-item span { font-size: 14px !important; line-height: 1.5 !important; }
.step-card b { font-size: 12px !important; }
.step-card span { font-size: 14px !important; line-height: 1.5 !important; }
.comparison-captions span, .record figcaption, .appliance h3 { font-size: 13px !important; }
</style>
<style>
/* ===== 메인 01~03 레이아웃 정리 (2026-10) ===== */
/* 01 교정고민 / 03 진행과정: 원본 이미지의 흰 여백을 잘라 같은 비율로 통일 */
.concern-section .concern-card .concern-photo-wrap { aspect-ratio: 1.9 / 1 !important; height: auto !important; overflow: hidden !important; padding: 0 !important; border: 0 !important; border-radius: 6px; background: #F4F1EE !important; }
.concern-section .concern-card .concern-photo-wrap .concern-photo { object-fit: cover !important; transform: scale(1.08); }
.concern-section .concern-card p { white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: -0.02em; }
.process .process-step .step-image { width: 106% !important; max-width: none !important; height: auto !important; margin-left: -3% !important; aspect-ratio: 2.1 / 1 !important; object-fit: cover !important; border-radius: 0 !important; }
.process .process-step { overflow: hidden; }
@media (min-width: 1024px) {
  /* 01~04 왼쪽 시작선과 제목 칸 너비 통일 */
  .concern-section .concern-inner { padding-left: 36px !important; padding-right: 6px !important; }
  .diagnosis-section .diagnosis-inner { padding-left: 30px !important; }
  .concern-layout, .diagnosis-layout { grid-template-columns: minmax(230px, 26%) minmax(0, 1fr) !important; column-gap: 31px !important; }
  /* 02: 원장 사진 높이를 오른쪽 패널과 맞춤 */
  .diagnosis-main { align-items: stretch !important; }
  .diagnosis-main .doctor-column { display: flex; }
  .diagnosis-main .doctor-photo { height: 100% !important; min-height: 100%; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 6px; }
}
/* 03: 링크 두 개를 한 줄에 같은 모양으로 */
.process .section-layout > div:last-child { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: flex-end; column-gap: 28px; }
.process .section-layout > div:last-child > .process-grid { flex: 0 0 100%; }
.process .diagnosis-button-row, .process .process-link { width: auto !important; margin-top: 22px !important; }
.process .diagnosis-button, .process .process-link .arrow-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding-bottom: 5px; color: #1A1A1A !important; border-bottom: 1px solid #EAD8CC !important; }
.concern-more .concern-arrow-link { white-space: nowrap; }
</style>
<style>
/* ===== 링크·버튼 화살표 제거 (2026-10) ===== */
.sa-hero-cta .arrow, .diagnosis-link-arrow, .button-arrow, #booking-form .primary-button > span, .tx-cases > span, .cj-item > span { display: none !important; }
.concern-arrow-link::after, .diagnosis-button::after, .arrow-link::after, .cp-go::after { content: none !important; display: none !important; }

/* ===== 메인 치료사례: 두 카드의 사진 시작 높이 맞춤 (글이 길어 줄바꿈돼도 사진은 같은 줄에서 시작) ===== */
@media (min-width: 768px) {
  .cases-block .case-grid { align-items: stretch !important; }
  .cases-block .case-card { display: flex !important; flex-direction: column; }
  .cases-block .case-card .case-meta { flex: 1 0 auto; margin-bottom: 6px; }
  .cases-block .case-card .before-after { margin-top: 0 !important; }
}
</style>
<style>
/* ===== 모바일 히어로 정리 (2026-10) ===== */
@media (max-width: 767px) {
  /* 메인: 문구를 위로, 인물은 아래로 */
  #body .main-hero { height: 620px !important; min-height: 620px !important; background: #F8F7F4 !important; }
  #body .main-hero .main-hero-bg { top: 230px !important; bottom: auto !important; height: 527px !important; -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 0, #000 90px); mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 0, #000 90px); }
  #body .main-hero::after { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #F8F7F4 0%, #F8F7F4 34%, rgba(248, 247, 244, 0) 50%) !important; }
  #body .main-hero .main-hero-inner { height: 100% !important; padding-top: 44px !important; padding-bottom: 0 !important; }
  #body .main-hero .main-hero-copy { padding-top: 0 !important; }

  /* 서브페이지: 히어로 높이 400px로 통일 */
  #body .about-hero, #body .concern-hero, #body .diagnosis-hero, #body .process-hero,
  #body .hero-wrapper > section.hero, #body .case-hero-block section.hero, #body .hero-wrap > section.hero { height: 400px !important; min-height: 400px !important; }
  #body .about-hero-inner, #body .diagnosis-hero-inner, #body .process-hero-inner,
  #body .case-hero-block .hero-inner, #body .hero-wrap .hero-inner { height: 100% !important; min-height: 0 !important; }

  /* 서브페이지: 문구 시작 위치·정렬 통일 */
  #body .about-hero-copy, #body .concern-hero-content, #body .diagnosis-hero-copy, #body .process-hero-copy,
  #body .hero-wrapper .hero-copy, #body .case-hero-block .hero-copy, #body .hero-wrap .hero-copy {
    position: absolute !important; top: 64px !important; left: 20px !important; right: 20px !important; bottom: auto !important;
    width: auto !important; max-width: none !important; margin: 0 !important; padding: 0 !important; transform: none !important;
    text-align: center !important; z-index: 5;
  }

  /* 서브페이지: 영문 라벨 11px */
  #body .about-hero-eyebrow, #body .concern-hero-eyebrow, #body .diagnosis-eyebrow, #body .process-eyebrow,
  #body .hero-wrapper .hero-eyebrow, #body .case-hero-block .hero-copy .eyebrow, #body .hero-wrap .hero-copy .eyebrow {
    margin: 0 0 12px !important; font-size: 11px !important; line-height: 1.5 !important; letter-spacing: .2em !important; text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  /* 서브페이지: 제목 26px */
  #body .about-hero-title, #body .concern-hero-content h1, #body .diagnosis-hero-copy h1, #body .process-hero-copy h1,
  #body .hero-wrapper .hero-copy h1, #body .case-hero-block .hero-copy h1, #body .hero-wrap .hero-copy h1,
  #body .hero-wrapper .hero-copy h1 *, #body .case-hero-block .hero-copy h1 *, #body .hero-wrap .hero-copy h1 *, #body .concern-hero-content h1 *, #body .diagnosis-hero-copy h1 *, #body .process-hero-copy h1 *,
  #body .fees-title {
    margin: 0 !important; font-size: 26px !important; line-height: 1.42 !important; letter-spacing: -0.02em !important;
  }

  /* 서브페이지: 설명 문구 15px */
  #body .hero-wrap .hero-copy > p:not(.eyebrow), #body .case-hero-block .hero-description { margin: 12px 0 0 !important; font-size: 15px !important; line-height: 1.7 !important; }

  /* 인물이 제목과 겹치지 않게 아래로 */
